topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct; rules of behavior acknowledged at hire and yearly (POL-05 4.1); sanctions procedure
Board risk committee oversees cyber risk quarterly, including the IBOP
Group CISO, IBOP system owner, and division security and compliance lead with defined reporting lines (POL-01)
evidence: POL-01; organization charts; IBOP SSP section 5

control_description: Role-based training for IBOP administrators, ROC operators, and technicians
gap: OT role-based training incomplete for technicians and integrators at acquired sites

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP and common control catalog; performance goals include security objectives
Asset, configuration, and log information used to run controls
gap: Reconciled OT inventory covers 231 of 296 sites (312 unlisted devices at 3 sampled sites)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies and the Facilities Support supplement communicated; incident reporting channel
control_owner: Facilities Support security and compliance lead

control_description: Service commitments and customer notice terms in contracts; customer security contacts
evidence: Contracts; contract security register; notification matrix
gap: Notice terms recorded for 71% of group contracts; the matrix has not been exercised

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service objectives (alarm handling, revocation within 4 hours, availability) defined in contracts and the SSP
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis with group roll-up (P01)
Fraud and insider misuse considered (for example insider misuse of cross-tenant administration, GR-13)
Significant changes (acquisitions, new AI features) assessed before go-live
gap: The 2024 acquisition joined the service without retiring legacy remote access; face verification (AI-001) and the closed-loop HVAC pilot (AI-004) started before AI review
remediation: Acquisition rule POL-01 4.14; AI change gate (P10)

control_description: Annual independent assessment by group internal audit (P07), also used for state contract exhibits
Deficiencies tracked to closure in the POA&M and reported to the board risk committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Control set from the SP 800-53 Moderate baseline selected by risk
General IT controls inherited from SYS-G1 to SYS-G3

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Controls deployed through group policies and the Facilities Support supplement (v2026)
control_owner: Facilities Support security and compliance lead

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO and MFA; PAM jump service with approval and recording for OT remote access; encryption with customer-managed keys
evidence: Identity and PAM configuration; jump service logs
gap: Vendor remote-support tools and integrator VPNs bypass the jump service at the 37 acquired sites; 22 integrator accounts without MFA. Expect exceptions for most of the 2026 period
remediation: Jump service with MFA at all sites (POAM-003, POAM-009, POAM-010)

control_description: Accounts requested and approved in identity governance; quarterly certification
gap: About 180 integrator accounts outside identity governance and certification

control_description: Role-based access in supervisory tools and access control tenants; just-in-time elevation
gap: 41 administrators hold a standing global administrator role across all customer tenants

control_description: Badge-controlled ROC-1 and ROC-2 with visitor logs and cameras
Media sanitization and secure disposal of retired gateways and workstations

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Edge gateways enforce deny-by-default between customer IT and OT networks
gap: 19 county and school sites on flat customer networks; integrator modems at acquired sites

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for cloud and site tunnels; data movement restricted to approved services

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on IBOP servers and ROC workstations; application allow-listing on engineering workstations at standard sites

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability scanning of cloud and SaaS components; passive OT discovery
gap: Passive OT vulnerability monitoring at 54% of sites

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: 24x7 SOC monitoring with SIEM; OT log review
gap: OT logs from 61% of sites; no detections for schedule or setpoint changes

control_description: Security events triaged and escalated under the group severity scale
Incident response plan and P08 runbook; customer notices by contract term
gap: Matrix incomplete and never exercised across divisions

control_description: Recovery of controllers and schedules from the hashed program repository
gap: Known-good programs exist for 61% of sites

control_description: Changes to programs, schedules, and platform components ticketed, tested, and approved
gap: Program changes by integrators at acquired sites made without tickets

control_description: Business impact analysis, building recovery procedures, and cyber insurance

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor SOC 2 reviews for the access control and video SaaS; integrator agreements
gap: Face verification module not covered by the access control vendor's SOC 2 report; 14 integrator subcontracts lack security terms
remediation: Vendor bridge letter and module assurance (P10); integrator addendum (POAM-017)

control_description: Capacity monitoring of supervisory servers, tenants, and alarm receivers
Replication to provider B every 15 minutes; daily immutable backups
evidence: Backup and replication reports; P07 restore test

control_description: Annual failover test of IBOP services to provider B
gap: Supervision and access control failover tested; ROC alarm monitoring dependency on the monitoring module not tested
